methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search beard-trimmer and hair-clipper models (budget, mid-range, professional) as of mid-2026. Independently re-verified against official brand pages (usa.philips.com, shop.panasonic.com, andis.com, us.braun.com, wahlusa.com, brio4life.com), retail listings (Amazon, Walmart, thisisbeauty.us), and editorial reviews (GroomReviews, ShavingAdvisor, ToolsAndToys). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or current street price at a primary retailer; cordless is true when the unit operates without a cord; runtime_min is cordless battery runtime at standard settings; null where a spec could not be confirmed from a primary source. accessedAt 2026-06-19. Two numeric corrections made vs draft: Braun AIO7440 list price 119.94->119.99 and Remington PG6025 runtime 70->65. All 11 products verified to exist; none removed.

products.priceNote: Last published Walmart price; Philips direct page marks product no longer available
products.provenance: Verified: 23-piece kit (Amazon/Philips title), DualCut self-sharpening stainless-steel blades, 5-hour (300-min) cordless runtime, 14 reinforced guards, max 16 mm. Price $59.99 per Walmart; Philips US direct page shows product discontinued.

products.name: Braun All-in-One Series 7 AIO7440
products.priceNote: List/MSRP price; widely discounted to ~$66-95 at major retailers

Released November 2022.

MG9730/40", "Prestige All-in-One Trimmer") and states 21 pieces, 6 hours runtime (=360 min), and self-sharpening DualCut titanium-coated steel blades. products.provenance: Panasonic UK official product page confirms ER-CKN1 is the MULTISHAPE Beard/Hair Trimmer Kit (Ni-MH), pairing the ER-CTN1 trimmer head with the ER-CBN1 Ni-MH main unit; its spec table lists 39 length settings, a 0.5~20mm cutting range, Approx. 50min cordless operating time, 45° nano-polished Japanese stainless-steel blades, and Number of Attachment 2. Panasonic's UK store corroborates the exact SKU (ER-CKN1-A311) and the same specs at an RRP of GBP 99.99. priceUsd is left null because no US MSRP exists for this Ni-MH SKU — the US shop carries only the Li-ion variant (SKU ER-CKL1-A, ER-CBL1 base, 90-min runtime) at $85, a distinct model, so converting the GBP RRP would be a guess.

products.name: Remington MB6850 Vacuum Beard Trimmer
products.priceNote: Walmart states "Current price is USD $59.99" (sold by Spectrum Brands HPC, Remington's parent). Amazon shows List Price EUR 52.50 in the fetched EU-locale view; Remington direct product page is discontinued (redirects to its Clippers & Trimmers collection), so no manufacturer MSRP available.
products.provenance: Model identity confirmed: Amazon lists Model Name "MB6850A-AT" and Manufacturer Part Number "MB6850" (Manufacturer: Remington), matching this exact vacuum beard/stubble trimmer. Walmart (Sold by Spectrum Brands HPC, Remington's parent) states "Current price is USD $59.99" and confirms up to 90 minutes of lithium cordless runtime, self-sharpening steel blades, and an adjustable comb with 11 length settings (2-18mm); Amazon corroborates the 90-min cordless runtime, self-sharpening steel blades, a comb locking to 11 length settings (2-18mm), and "Included Components: 1 Adjustable Comb". The Remington direct product page now redirects to its Clippers & Trimmers collection (discontinued from the brand store), so the brand-operated Walmart listing serves as source. length_settings uses the explicit 11 comb settings stated verbatim on both pages (the marketing "13 length and style settings" also counts two style heads); releaseDate left null as no fetched page states a release/first-available date.
